name: repo-guide-container-choice
body: `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` (under `solution.container.opencode-suite`) covers the two agent prompt files, and `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` is a second component under `solution.container.scanner-cli`, the container whose repository it documents, `AGENTS.md`. Both components are realised-by `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation`. `AGENTS.md` sits outside the `opencode-suite/` distribution: the suite embeds the two prompts via `include_str!` and installs them through `apg init`, while `AGENTS.md` is the repository guide.
